extras.notes: oriented as worn on the right shoulder (outside = +X, front = -Y), stands on the lowest lame and the arm strap; domed steel cop with rolled brass edge and a brass spiral, three overlapping flared steel lames with brass edges and rivets, leather neck strap with brass buckle and leather arm strap closing the arm opening; mirror on X for the left shoulder; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
